findings.title: Client-controlled `limit` is unbounded and `offset` is not validated
findings.body: `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` is passed straight to `.limit(...)` with no upper cap. Any user who can see the group can request `limit=10000000` and force a full-group serialization, which is a cheap DoS on large groups. A negative `limit` or `offset` from the client can also raise a DB error and a 500. The previous code at least had a default cap for automatic groups. Clamp `limit` to a sane range (for example 1..200) and `offset` to >= 0.

findings.title: Public group members page now silently shows only the first 50 members
findings.body: `GroupsController#members` now returns at most 50 users by default for every group. Before, non-automatic groups were returned in full. The public `group/members.hbs` template was only changed to iterate `members`. It has no paging controls and never advances `offset`, so any group with more than 50 members shows a truncated list with no way to see the rest. Pagination was added only in the admin UI.

findings.title: totalPages is off by one when user_count is an exact multiple of limit
findings.body: `totalPages` is `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1`. With 50 users and a limit of 50 it reports 2 pages, so the pager shows "1/2" and the next arrow is enabled. Clicking it moves to offset 50 and shows an empty page. It should be `Math.ceil(user_count / limit)`.

findings.title: addMembers never clears the input and has no error handling
findings.body: `addMembers` does not reset `usernames` after the add, and the model's `addMembers` promise has no failure handler (the in-code TODO acknowledges the missing clear). Clicking Add twice re-submits the same names. An error response, such as the 422 for automatic groups, is swallowed with no feedback to the admin.

findings.title: Reloading after removeMember can leave the pager on an empty page
findings.body: After a remove, `findMembers()` reuses the existing `offset`. When the removed member was the only one on the last page, the new page is requested at an offset equal to the new total. The server returns an empty list and the view shows a blank page. The offset should be re-clamped after the removal, for example by stepping back one page.

findings.title: Members are no longer loaded before render, so stale or empty list shows briefly
findings.body: `afterModel` previously waited for the member load. Now `setupController` fires `findMembers()` without waiting. The cached Group object keeps its old `members`, `offset` and `user_count` from an earlier visit, so the previous page or members are displayed until the request returns. The error is not handled either.

findings.title: No test for the new paginated members endpoint or its edge cases
findings.body: `GroupsController#members` changed its response shape to `{members, meta}` and gained limit/offset pagination, but no spec covers it. Nothing tests the meta values, offset/limit behaviour, or bounds. The add/remove-member specs also never check that a nonexistent username or user id is handled. Removing the old patch specs without replacement leaves those edge cases untested.
